steps.label: Hits in the first scan
steps.text: In the first scan AI stood on {{h05-dots.first_hits}} of {{h05-dots.pairs}} homepages, each dot one.
steps.claim: That many homepages said AI in the first scan.
steps.unit: 1 dot = 1 homepage with the word AI in the first scan.

steps.label: Missing in the second scan
steps.text: {{h05-dots.lost_hits}} of them lost the word in the second scan, {{h05-dots.rescan_days}} days later, by another route.
steps.claim: That many lose the word the second time.
steps.unit: 1 dot = 1 homepage with the word AI in the first scan.

steps.label: Almost every second one
steps.text: Almost every second hit, interval {{h05-dots.rescan_lost.range}}. Only {{h05-dots.new_hits}} were new. This may be the measurement, not the pages.
steps.claim: {{h05-dots.lost_hits}} of {{h05-dots.first_hits}} lose the AI word the second time.
steps.unit: 1 dot = 1 homepage with the word AI in the first scan.
